name: Nanka Chigau!?
source:
You hit it off with a pleasant young man via a dating app. But when he shows up, he turns out to actually be a gloomy guy!

Would you go on a date with him? Or call it quits?

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13211]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
你通过约会应用程序与一位令人愉快的年轻人一拍即合。但当他出现的时候，却发现他其实是一个阴暗的家伙！

你愿意和他去约会吗？还是就此罢休？

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13211]Novelgame[/url]]
